purpose: Preserve masked mission screenshots and viewport metadata across successive Playwright invocations without cross-test collisions.

scope.source: Direct import of the integrated helper; no copied or modified implementation.

executions.purpose: Two independent tests invoke the exact helper with the same capture name.
A later Playwright invocation clears temporary output and verifies both durable pairs.

fingerprints.captureHashDefinition: UTF-8 source beginning at export async function captureMissionViewport and ending after its closing brace, excluding the blank line before readControlGeometry.

postProofComparison.subsequentChange: Only expectControlUnobstructed synchronization changed: finite running transitions and two animation frames.

limitations: The injected HEAD is synthetic; this is not an official CI artifact.
The proof covers capture persistence and classification, not the subsequent synchronization change.
The proof does not exercise GitHub artifact upload, the full application or PostgreSQL.
The next official CI must confirm retained real screenshots and metadata for its own HEAD.
